metadata.Name: Japanese Fake News Dataset
metadata.Description: A Japanese fake news dataset with fine-grained labeling based on detailed investigations of existing fake news datasets
Provider: NARA Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: Annotation-Scheme Reconstruction for Fake News and Japanese Fake News Dataset
Affiliations: NARA Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: This paper proposes a novel annotation scheme to capture various aspects of fake news and constructs the first Japanese fake news dataset. The annotation scheme is based on detailed investigations of existing fake news datasets and includes fine-grained labeling of fake news from various perspectives such as intention, harmfulness, and target. The dataset is constructed by annotating 307 news stories verified by Fact Check Initiative Japan between July 2019 and October 2021.
